checks.evidence: Codex in-app browser at http://127.0.0.1:4325/ with an isolated temporary fixture authentication file and test/fixtures/fake-codex.mjs

A synthetic English B2B offer question completed with owner → two Head Consultant task-only handoffs → two specialist positions to Critic → Critic challenge → relevant specialist reply → one Head Consultant owner synthesis. checks.limit: The source object was fixture data; this does not execute U-05 current-topic research acceptance.

checks.name: voice disclosure and start boundary

checks.limit: No Ukrainian transcript, Safari, Chrome device, Stop/Cancel completion or browser-permission result was captured in this run. QA-R28–QA-R32, QA-R50, QA-R55 and QA-U01 remain not_run.
